periods.status: wrongfully convicted/imprisoned; sentence still extremely long but reduced after Jeanne capture
periods.summary: Aria's mother, bearing a false 864-year sentence due to I-U related culprits. Aria's central motive in this volume is to arrest Maken/Jeanne and other culprits to reduce Kanae's sentence and reopen the case; after Jeanne's capture her sentence is sharply reduced.

relationships.status: Aria fights to clear her false conviction.
Jeanne is responsible for a portion of the false sentence.
I-U actors caused or exploited her false conviction.

evidence.quote: Aria's urgent mission is saving her mother Kanzaki Kanae.
Maken's arrest can reduce Kanae's sentence to 635 years and perhaps reopen the case.
Jeanne's arrest sharply reduces Kanae's false sentence.
